title: QuietTicket
summary: Community voting prototype with one-time claim tickets, sealed ballots and a reveal tally. November 4 source and public demo review: the browser simulation creates polls, mints and claims tickets, casts a ballot, rejects a repeated vote and reveals the tally. The Rust Ootle template scaffold is MIT-licensed; the creator describes a future Esmeralda/Sapient path, with no live deployment claimed in the reviewed submission. The threat model notes that the simulation reveal key is held in-page and ticket links are bearer credentials. The recording shows the browser simulation, not network transactions or a privacy/security certification.
cardSummary: Model one-time voting tickets, sealed ballots and a reveal tally in a walletless browser simulation.
